messages:
Maya: Heads-up 99CloudAtlas x Redwood co-marketing plan. Scope: marketplace listing + joint how-to blog + 40-min webinar. Target week: Jun 8. Main hook: "deploy inference in 10m w/ 40% lower cost" (draft).

Owen: Prefer June 9 to avoid product sprint release. Also target infra/platform folks; show reproducible steps.

Rita: I need partner assets: SVG logo, 2 screenshots, short 120-word blurb, and approval on benchmark claims. Who has timeline?

Maya: Rita owns assets (due Tue). Leo to own webinar runbook + landing page copy. I'll coordinate partner approvals.

Leo: Registration form -> Marketo. Routing: tag leads with utm_campaign=atlas-rw-jun and push to SFDC queue "Partners/CloudAtlas". Form fields: email, company, role, use-case.

FormBot: Form created: https://forms.redwood/atlas-rw-jun. Recording auto-upload to gdrive/marketing/partners/atlas-jun.

Owen: For the blog let's include a short CLI reproduce block and a results table (percent delta vs baseline). Keep technical appendix in a repo.

Rita: Legal note: partner signed off on a percent delta only (no raw numbers). We'll supply a chart of relative improvement.

Maya: Action items: Rita (assets, Tue), Leo (landing + form, Fri), Owen (blog first draft Mon). Quick sync Thurs 11am PT. :calendar:
